leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a depth-first search (DFS) function to traverse a grid representation of islands and water
Initialize and manipulate a 2D grid data structure to represent the map of islands
Apply boundary checking logic to prevent traversal beyond grid edges
Construct a main algorithm that iterates through all grid cells to count islands
Configure visited tracking to mark cells that have been explored during traversal
Update the grid state by marking visited land cells to avoid redundant counting
Integrate the DFS traversal with the main counting loop to produce the final island count
